nondeterministic.sentence: Detector D0 is non-deterministic: the Z-basis reset (R) on qubit 0 (line 1, after 0 TICKs) anti-commutes with what D0 tracks, so its parity is random even without noise. The Pauli it is sensitive to there is X0. Declared: D0 at line 4. This is a static property of the circuit text, independent of noise or sampled data. Common sources are a shifted or missing DETECTOR rec target, a wrong rec offset, or a measurement/reset in the wrong basis.
